title: Partner Portal — Agencies & Vendors (about 80 partners, India commercial and medical)
summary: Creative, media, event, travel, field staffing and research partners onboarding with MSA, NDA, GST, insurance and anti-bribery documents, compliance due diligence for high-risk partners, SOWs issued and accepted in the portal, requests against SOWs with priority SLAs and a comment thread, monthly SLA scorecards with service credits signed off maker-checker, and partner and request 360 pages.
